Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray report for Figure 1a explicitly describes "diffuse nodular opacity in the lungs bilaterally" and "diffuse bilateral patchy air space opacities," which visually correspond to opacities distributed throughout the middle and lower fields. This bilateral, diffuse pattern is characteristic of amiodarone-induced pneumonitis, distinguishing it from unilateral or purely upper-lobe distributions. (guided by t000001)
